# dsh-grok-4-6-support
A DeepSeek Harness profile bundle that adds `grok-4.6` to the existing `xAI` provider. The Models se
ttings page shows exactly these xAI models after installation:
The bundle extends pi-ai's in-process xAI catalog before `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` starts. This p
reserves the built-in route's per-model protocol selection: Grok 4.3 keeps OpenAI Chat Completions,
while Grok 4.5 and Grok 4.6 use OpenAI Responses.
## Requirements
- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6` or a compatible release that provides `@earendil-works/pi-ai` `^0.82

.1`.
- Node.js `22.19.0` or later.
- An xAI API key, supplied through the Models settings page or `X

js `22.19.0` or later.
- An xAI API key, supplied through the Models settings page or `XAI_API_KEY`.
